## Final Assessment – Not a Godot Bug

I have now tested across multiple systems:

- **AMD/Intel Bare Metal:** Godot works perfectly, suspend/resume works perfectly.
- **NVIDIA Bare Metal:** Godot crashes, suspend/resume crashes, sometimes Godot doesn't even start.
- **VM with NVIDIA passthrough:** Same issues.

The only variable that correlates with the crash is **NVIDIA GPU + Linux**.

Given the long history of NVIDIA-related suspend/resume issues on Linux (discussed on kernel mailing lists as recently as January 2026), I conclude that **this is not a Godot bug**. Godot is merely exposing an underlying driver or kernel issue.

I recommend closing this issue. The fix, if any, must come from NVIDIA or the Linux kernel community.

Yeah it's definitely an issue with Nvidia's proprietary drivers, I've tested:

**nvidia-driver-580 (580.159.03-0ubuntu0.22.04.1)** - Forward+ project crashes after pm-suspend
**nvidia-driver-595 (595.71.05-0ubuntu0.22.04.1)** - can't open a Forward+ project at all, instantly crashes
**xserver-xorg-video-nouveau (1:1.0.17-2build1)** - no crash, works even after pm-suspend
